rationale: The candidate gives a concrete supported access path: `cmd.Flag("flagName")`. The preserved bundle explicitly states that `Command.Flag` “climbs up the command tree” and, if the local lookup fails, calls `persistentFlag` (`command.go:1794-1803`). The included `persistentFlag` implementation checks the command’s persistent flags and then `parentsPflags` (`command.go:1805-1816`). The recommendation to declare the option as a persistent flag on a parent/root is also consistent with `Flags()` applying persistent flags declared by all parents (`command.go:1641-1653`).
